name: retroplug2-ui
description: RetroPlug workspace root: the JS build toolchain (esbuild) and the runtime deps bundled into the UI.

scripts.test:cli: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-ui-test && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js ui
scripts.smoke: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/mgb
scripts.reaper:analyze-lsdj-sync: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/lsdj/sync_pattern && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern_sys0.wav /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern_sys1.wav
scripts.reaper:mgb-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/mgb && tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke.rpp build tools/reaper-mgb-author.lua /tmp/mgb_smoke_author.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-arduinoboy-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/lsdj/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro && tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-arduinoboy-author.lua /tmp/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro_author.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-arduinoboy-metro: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro.rpp && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-arduinoboy-metro.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/lsdj/lsdj_midi_metro && tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_metro.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-midi-author.lua /tmp/lsdj_midi_metro_author.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-metro: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_metro.rpp && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-midi-metro.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-drift-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 retroplug-cli cli-regenerate && node scripts/run-ts-tests.js cli gb/lsdj/lsdj_midi_drift && tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_drift.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-midi-drift-author.lua /tmp/lsdj_midi_drift_author.rplg
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-drift: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_drift.rpp && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-midi-drift.wav --drift
